nodes.text: Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) causes cold-like symptoms: cough, fever, congestion & shortness of breath. Spreads via droplets & surfaces. High risk for infants, elderly & immunocompromised. Prevent with handwashing, masks & distancing. No vaccine yet. #HMPV #HealthAwareness https://t.co/BXKO76xeow
